positioning.headline: Full-stack engineer with strong delivery across web, data, and AI-enabled product workflows.
strengths: Ships production features end-to-end across frontend, backend, and cloud workflows.

highlights: Led development of Connect2Talents initial web app using Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind across 10+ product screens.

Designed resilient OCR and fallback pipeline; reduced manual document processing time by 50%.
Implemented Pydantic-validated APIs and Google Drive OAuth 2.0 integration.
Delivered Power BI dashboard and automated intake workflow that reduced manual reporting time by 50% across 5 teams in a 100+ employee organization.
Built SQL data pipelines with transformation and validation logic, replacing a days-long reporting cycle with decision-ready insights.
Revamped a full-stack web app with modern Next.js components and Redux state architecture.
Optimized Node.js and PostgreSQL REST APIs, reducing response latency by 20%.
Designed pagination and schema updates to support 200+ daily transactions reliably.
Implemented CI/CD pipelines supporting 25+ production deployments.
Built API dependency mapping to reduce release risk and improve reliability.
Led and coached 30+ sales floor associates while maintaining daily execution and service quality.
Resolved complex customer and operations issues through root-cause problem solving and clear team coordination.
